input.quote: Kubient makes no representation or warranty and expressly disclaims, and Customer understands and acknowledges, that there is no guarantee that any minimum level of revenue or profit will be generated by either Party as a result of the Services or this Agreement.
input.rationale: Compensation is a revenue share defined per Exhibit; there is no minimum purchase, committed spend, take-or-pay or shortfall obligation on Customer, and no volume cap on our usage. We should re-check individual Exhibits when issued, but the MSA itself is compliant.

input.quote: (iv) and each Party will return or destroy any of the other Party's Confidential Information then in its possession.
input.rationale: Section 4(c) provides only that Kubient ceases the Services, the licence is revoked and Confidential Information is returned or destroyed — with the destruction option risking loss of our data and no transition assistance or data-export obligation. We insert a wind-down paragraph: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, then certified deletion.
